steps.en: The success page lists the transaction details
A table shows each fine that was paid
steps.id: Tabel menampilkan setiap denda yang dibayar

steps.en: Works the same for every payment mode
steps.id: Berlaku sama untuk semua mode bayar

steps.en: Print downloads the receipt as a zip, not a single PDF file
steps.id: Print mengunduh receipt sebagai zip, bukan satu file PDF
steps.why_en: The receipt arrives zipped, there is no on-screen view, and a failed download shows no message.
steps.why_id: Receipt datang dalam zip, tidak ada tampilan di layar, dan unduhan gagal tidak diberi pesan.

steps.en: The system builds a PDF receipt per paid fine
steps.id: Sistem membuat receipt PDF untuk tiap denda yang dibayar
steps.why_en: Receipts are not limited to successful payments when requested by transaction number, and the template cannot be checked.
steps.why_id: Receipt tidak dibatasi pembayaran sukses bila diminta lewat nomor transaksi, dan isi template tidak bisa dicek.
